replication.target_description: Study 6: single-colored versus multicolored Smarties photo quantity estimates, independent t test; 161 retained participants (77 and 84).

n.quote: A total of 161 participants did not meet the exclusion criteria.
n.exclusions: 259 recruited; excluded missing estimates and estimates of 1 or 0.

reported_success.quote: we again failed to replicate the hypothesized effect that variety would reduce perceived quantity.

notes: Supplied replication p. 13 is Table 3, body Results p. 9. Original study identifier and candy/page locator conflict; original primary unavailable. Replication estimates photographs, not amount poured. Rank-sum p=.037 belongs to a different test and was not paired with d.
